2610.12386.title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
2610.12386.paper_summary: The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/
2610.12386.paper_summary_zh: 目前改善機器人基礎模型（RFM）的主流方法依賴於更大的模型、更多的機器人示範以及昂貴的大規模訓練。<lb/>我們展示了一種有效且高效的互補方法：正確的推理配方可以顯著提高現有最先進RFM的零次任務表現。我們將這個配方稱為ARC。<lb/>它由三個關鍵成分組成：推理痕跡、一個可擴展的自動標記管道，以及一種將預訓練RFM適應以使用這些痕跡進行控制的策略。<lb/>首先，我們發現有效的推理痕跡應該基於機器人的下一個行動並解釋其因果結構：為什麼這個行動是合適的以及它應該產生什麼效果。<lb/>其次，我們展示這些痕跡可以從現有的示範中自動生成，使我們能夠從DROID構建ARC-Trace-DROID，而無需收集新的機器人數據。<lb/>第三，我們展示了最先進的VLA（視覺語言模型）如$π_{0.5}$和WAM（行為模型）如Cosmos3-Nano-Policy如何學會使用這些痕跡進行控制，並根據每個模型的架構和能力進行微調和推理。<lb/>使用ARC，我們在零次RFM表現上獲得了前所未有的增益，據我們所知，這些增益是在沒有額外機器人示範或基礎規模訓練的情況下取得的。<lb/>經過適應的模型在RoboLab-120和MolmoSpaces上建立了新的最先進紀錄，在RoboLab-Reasoning-50上獲得了高達50個百分點的增益。在真實機器人上，ARC使得$π_{0.5}$的任務成功率提高了82.2個百分點。<lb/>項目網站：https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/
